content.query:
NTANetAnalytics
| where SubType == "FlowLog"
| extend VM_s = case(
    tolong(AllowedInFlows) > 0 or tolong(DeniedInFlows) > 0, DestVm,
    tolong(AllowedOutFlows) > 0 or tolong(DeniedOutFlows) > 0, SrcVm,
    coalesce(DestVm, SrcVm)
)
| where isnotempty(VM_s)
| summarize TotalFlows = count() by bin(FlowIntervalStartTime, 1h), VM_s
| project TimeGenerated = FlowIntervalStartTime, VM_s, TotalFlows
content.title: Traffic flows over time on virtual machines

content.query:
NTANetAnalytics
| where SubType == "FlowLog"
| summarize TotalFlows = count() by FlowType
content.title: Traffic flow types

content.query:
union
(
    NTANetAnalytics
    | where SubType == "FlowLog"
    | where isnotempty(SrcNic)
    | project
        SubscriptionId = tostring(SrcSubscription),
        NICName = tostring(SrcNic),
        VMName = tostring(SrcVm),
        AllowedOutFlows = coalesce(tolong(AllowedOutFlows), 0),
        DeniedOutFlows = coalesce(tolong(DeniedOutFlows), 0),
        AllowedInFlows = long(0),
        DeniedInFlows = long(0)
),
(
    NTANetAnalytics
    | where SubType == "FlowLog"
    | where isnotempty(DestNic)
    | project
        SubscriptionId = tostring(DestSubscription),
        NICName = tostring(DestNic),
        VMName = tostring(DestVm),
        AllowedOutFlows = long(0),
        DeniedOutFlows = long(0),
        AllowedInFlows = coalesce(tolong(AllowedInFlows), 0),
        DeniedInFlows = coalesce(tolong(DeniedInFlows), 0)
)
| summarize
    AllowedOutFlows = sum(AllowedOutFlows),
    DeniedOutFlows = sum(DeniedOutFlows),
    AllowedInFlows = sum(AllowedInFlows),
    DeniedInFlows = sum(DeniedInFlows)
    by SubscriptionId, NICName, VMName
| extend TotalFlows = AllowedOutFlows + DeniedOutFlows + AllowedInFlows + DeniedInFlows
| project SubscriptionId, NICName, VMName, AllowedOutFlows, DeniedOutFlows, AllowedInFlows, DeniedInFlows, TotalFlows
| order by TotalFlows desc
content.title: Flows on network interfaces and virtual machines

content.query:
NTANetAnalytics
| where SubType == "FlowLog" and FlowType == "MaliciousFlow"
| extend CountryOrRegion = iff(FlowType == "AzurePublic", AzureRegion, Country)
| where FlowDirection == "Inbound"
| where isnotempty(SrcIp)
| summarize
    FlowCount = sum(coalesce(tolong(AllowedInFlows), 0) + coalesce(tolong(DeniedInFlows), 0)),
    AllowedInFlows = sum(coalesce(tolong(AllowedInFlows), 0)),
    DeniedInFlows = sum(coalesce(tolong(DeniedInFlows), 0))
    by IPAdress = strcat(SrcIp, " (", CountryOrRegion, ")")
| sort by AllowedInFlows desc
content.title: Malicious IP address communication

content.query:
NTANetAnalytics

| extend FlowCount = coalesce(tolong(AllowedInFlows), 0) + coalesce(tolong(DeniedInFlows), 0)
| extend Country = iff(isempty(Country), "Unknown", Country)
| summarize FlowCount = sum(FlowCount) by Country
| sort by FlowCount desc

content.query:
NTANetAnalytics
| where SubType == "FlowLog" and FlowType == "MaliciousFlow"
| where FlowDirection == "Inbound"
| where isnotempty(DestIp)
| summarize AllowedInFlows = sum(coalesce(tolong(AllowedInFlows), 0)) by DestIp, DestVm, DestSubscription
| extend Computer = strcat(
    DestIp, " (",
    iff(isempty(DestVm), "Unknown VM", DestVm),
    " - ",
    iff(isempty(DestSubscription), "Unknown subscription", DestSubscription),
    ")"
)
| project Computer, AllowedInFlows
| sort by AllowedInFlows desc
content.title: Most attacked machines

content.query:
NTANetAnalytics
| where SubType == "FlowLog" and tostring(FaSchemaVersion) == "3" and FlowType == "MaliciousFlow" and FlowDirection == "Inbound"
| where isnotempty(DestSubnet)
| summarize AllowedInFlows = sum(coalesce(tolong(AllowedInFlows), 0)) by DestSubnet, DestSubscription
| extend Subnet = strcat(
    DestSubnet, " (",
    iff(isempty(DestSubscription), "Unknown subscription", DestSubscription),
    ")"
)
| project Subnet, AllowedInFlows
| sort by AllowedInFlows desc
content.title: Most attacked subnets

content.query:
NTANetAnalytics
| where SubType == "FlowLog" and FlowType == "MaliciousFlow" and FlowDirection == "Inbound"
| where isnotempty(DestIp)
| extend AllowedInFlows = coalesce(tolong(AllowedInFlows), 0), DeniedInFlows = coalesce(tolong(DeniedInFlows), 0)
| summarize
    AllowedInFlows = sum(AllowedInFlows),
    DeniedInFlows = sum(DeniedInFlows)
    by IPAddress = DestIp, VM = DestVm, Subnet = DestSubnet, Subscription = DestSubscription
| extend FlowCount = AllowedInFlows + DeniedInFlows
| extend VMParts = split(VM, "/"), SubnetParts = split(Subnet, "/")
| extend
    VMResourceId = iff(
        isnotempty(Subscription) and array_length(VMParts) >= 2,
        strcat("/subscriptions/", Subscription, "/resourceGroups/", tostring(VMParts[0]), "/providers/Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/", tostring(VMParts[1])),
        ""
    ),
    VNetResourceId = iff(
        isnotempty(Subscription) and array_length(SubnetParts) >= 2,
        strcat("/subscriptions/", Subscription, "/resourceGroups/", tostring(SubnetParts[0]), "/providers/Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks/", tostring(SubnetParts[1])),
        ""
    )
| project IPAddress, VM = VMResourceId, VNet = VNetResourceId, Subscription, FlowCount, AllowedInFlows, DeniedInFlows
| order by AllowedInFlows desc
content.title: Attacked resources

content.query:
NTANetAnalytics
| where SubType == "FlowLog" and FlowType == "MaliciousFlow" and FlowDirection == "Inbound"
| extend AllowedInFlows = coalesce(tolong(AllowedInFlows), 0), DeniedInFlows = coalesce(tolong(DeniedInFlows), 0)
| summarize
    FlowCount = sum(AllowedInFlows + DeniedInFlows),
    AllowedInFlows = sum(AllowedInFlows),
    DeniedInFlows = sum(DeniedInFlows)
    by L7Protocol, DestPort
| extend L7Protocol = strcat(iff(isempty(L7Protocol), "Unknown", L7Protocol), " (", tostring(DestPort), ")")
| project L7Protocol, FlowCount, AllowedInFlows, DeniedInFlows
| top 10 by AllowedInFlows desc
content.title: Malicious traffic, by application ports

content.query:
NTANetAnalytics
| where SubType == "FlowLog" and tostring(FaSchemaVersion) == "3" and FlowType == "MaliciousFlow" and FlowDirection == "Inbound"
| extend AllowedIn = coalesce(tolong(AllowedInFlows), 0), DeniedIn = coalesce(tolong(DeniedInFlows), 0)
| summarize FlowCount = sum(AllowedIn + DeniedIn) by L4Protocol
| extend L4Protocol = case(
    toupper(L4Protocol) == "T", "TCP",
    toupper(L4Protocol) == "U", "UDP",
    isempty(L4Protocol), "Unknown",
    L4Protocol
)
| project L4Protocol, FlowCount
| sort by FlowCount desc
content.title: Malicious traffic protocols

content.json: ## NSG rule hits by malicious traffic

content.query:
NTANetAnalytics
| where SubType == "FlowLog"
| where FlowType == "MaliciousFlow"
| where FlowDirection == "Inbound"
| extend AllowedFlowCount = coalesce(tolong(AllowedInFlows), 0)
| where AllowedFlowCount > 0
| extend
    NSG = iff(isempty(AclGroup), "Unspecified", tostring(AclGroup)),
    Rule = iff(isempty(AclRule), "Unspecified", replace_regex(tostring(AclRule), @"^(userrule_|defaultrule_)", ""))
| summarize TotalHits = sum(AllowedFlowCount) by NSG, Rule
| extend FullRule = strcat(NSG, "/", Rule)
| project FullRule, TotalHits
| top 10 by TotalHits desc
content.title: NSG rules allowing inbound malicious traffic

content.query:
NTANetAnalytics
| where SubType == "FlowLog"
| where tostring(FaSchemaVersion) == "3"
| where FlowType == "MaliciousFlow"
| where FlowDirection == "Inbound"
| extend AllowedFlowCount = coalesce(tolong(AllowedInFlows), 0)
| where AllowedFlowCount > 0
| extend nsg = tostring(AclGroup), rule = replace_regex(tostring(AclRule), @"^(defaultrule_|userrule_)", "")
| where isnotempty(nsg) and isnotempty(rule)
| summarize TotalHits = sum(AllowedFlowCount) by nsg, rule
| extend nsgrule = strcat(nsg, "/", rule)
| project nsg, rule, nsgrule, TotalHits
| sort by TotalHits desc
content.title: NSG rules allowing inbound malicious traffic
